title: Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)
rationale: Most breaches happen through third parties. CISOs need to know which vendors introduce the most regulatory exposure. This is a large new module requiring its own data model, UI, and workflows. Deferred to Future because it does not extend an existing module — it is a net-new pillar.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want to maintain a vendor registry with risk tiers, so that I can prioritize oversight of high-risk vendors.
acceptance_criteria: Manager can add vendors with name, category, and tier (Critical, High, Medium, Low).
Tier is auto-suggested based on data access level and integration type.
Dashboard shows vendor count by tier.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want to send inherent risk questionnaires to vendors and score their responses, so that I can objectively assess their risk.
acceptance_criteria: Manager can select a questionnaire template.
System sends the questionnaire to the vendor's contact email.
Responses are scored and an inherent risk score is calculated.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want to upload a vendor's SOC 2 report and have the AI summarize findings, so that I can quickly assess their compliance posture.
acceptance_criteria: Manager can upload a SOC 2 PDF.
AI extracts key findings, exceptions, and complementary user entity controls.
Summary is stored against the vendor record.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want to track vendor contract renewal dates and re-assessment schedules, so that assessments stay current.
acceptance_criteria: Manager can set contract expiry and next assessment date.
System sends reminders before re-assessment is due.
Overdue vendor assessments are flagged on dashboard.
